thread:
tom: Hey folks, unboxing my company MBP (serial C02YQ1XXXXX). MDM workflow jumps to the blue 'Connect to network' screen then shows 'Enrollment failed: device assigned to another organization'. Is this something I can fix or do you need to contact Apple?

it-support: thanks for the heads up. that error usually means the device's ABM (Apple Business Manager) record still points to a previous tenant. do you have the serial handy? (you can DM if you want)

tom: posted above but here it is again C02YQ1XXXXX. bought from company HR stock, came sealed.

emma: tagging infra here. @it-support have we recently transferred a batch of devices? could be an accidental reassign in ABM.

it-support: not on our side. inventory shows device id not present for that serial. I'll query ABM now.

abm-bot: Query result for C02YQ1XXXXX: AssignedTo: unknown_tenant@oldvendor, Status: Assigned, LastModified: 2026-03-18T09:12:05Z

emma: yep looks like vendor failed to clear assignment before drop-ship. we need an ABM reclamation request via Apple Business Support. I'll open a ticket but that can take 1-3 business days.

tom: ugh. I need the laptop working for onboarding tomorrow. any temporary workarounds?

it-support: options: (1) we can provide a temporary loaner that is already in our ABM, (2) skip automated DEP enrollment and do a manual setup with a local admin account, then enroll that machine into Kandji via web enroll post-setup. manual setup loses the zero-touch benefits and triggers extra checks for Secure Boot / SSV, (3) ask vendor for immediate revoke and reassign (fastest if vendor co-operates).

emma: do you mind if we do manual setup for now? we can reprovision later once ABM cleared. it will require temporary admin and you'll need to confirm FileVault is enabled manually.

tom: manual sounds fine. steps? I prefer to do it with IT on Zoom so I don't mess up secure boot.

it-support: ok I'll DM you temporary admin creds and a short checklist. main steps: 1) create local admin account during OOBE (choose a strong password), 2) finish macOS setup, 3) run our bootstrap script to install Kandji agent and profiles, 4) enable FileVault and copy recovery key to Okta, 5) install Rosetta if needed and homebrew.

it-support: bootstrap commands (will require sudo once you have admin):

```
# download bootstrap and run
curl -fsSL https://internal.redwood/bootstrap.sh | sudo bash
# install kandji agent
sudo /usr/local/bin/kandji enroll --url https://enroll.redwood-example.kandji.com/XXXXXXXX --token TEMP-XXXX
```

it-support: note: because ABM isn't attached, some kernel extensions or new system entitlements may ask you to allow in System Settings > Privacy & Security; we'll walk through those.

tom: running now. quick Q: will this block me from receiving future automated updates or SSO certs?

emma: short answer: once ABM is fixed and device is re-added to our org, we will remote reprovision. you'll keep the same user account but we may need to boot into recovery to re-enable certain security flags. we'll coordinate a low-impact window.

inventory-bot: Inventory note: temp-manual-provision created for C02YQ1XXXXX by it-support at 1955001258, status: pending verification.

it-support: all set on our side, @tom you should see bootstrap progress in Console. ping when FileVault prompt appears and we'll confirm Okta escrow.

tom: FileVault prompt showed, enabled. Okta has a recovery key entry now. Kandji agent shows 'enrolled (manual)'. thanks for the quick help.

emma: great. opened Apple Business Support case SR# 123456789 to request device reclamation from old vendor. i'll post updates in this thread.

tom: appreciate it. hopefully vendor responds fast. thanks for the loaner offer but manual was painless with guidance. first-week win.

it-support: closing action items: 1) monitor SR#123456789, 2) when Apple reassigns, schedule reprovision -> we will coordinate with @tom for minimal downtime, 3) mark inventory entry as manual until reprovision complete. reopen if anything breaks. :thumbsup:
